release_use_policy: CC BY 4.0 permits commercial use with attribution. These provider-declared PCM samples are development-only Tier B sparse and bandwidth-limited hard negatives. They are not Tier A masters and must never count toward the disjoint release corpus.

sources.title: NSynth validation split
sources.ground_truth_basis: Google documents four-second musical-note examples distributed as 16-bit PCM WAV and generated from annotated commercial sample-library instruments.
sources.partition_basis: official instrument ID; NSynth documents that validation and test instruments do not overlap with the train split
sources.limitations: The provider does not establish the pre-dataset encoding history of the commercial samples. Audio is monophonic 16 kHz single notes rather than complete recordings, so this is Tier B invariant evidence only.
